svg.title: Four Checks Before Capital Leaves the Acquisition Account
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-statutory-and-risk-preflight; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Capital Leaves the Acquisition Account; subtitle: Proceed only when each applicable question has documented evidence.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Four sequential binary checks: a supported yes advances; an unresolved no routes the package to remediation or rejection. Numeric values indicate check order, not probability. Texas citations apply to Texas interests; Oklahoma docket practice requires its own commission records and governing rules.; caption: The decision path separates property ownership, collectible economics, public development evidence, and capital structure. Passing one check does not answer the other three.; stages: label: Does recorded title support the conveyed interest?; value: Yes: advance; no: cure title or reject; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Test seller authority, severed estate ownership, reservations, probate, liens, and execution formalities. For Texas assets, examine Property Code Sections 5.021 and 13.001. A recorder index hit alone does not establish marketable title or resolve competing interests.; label: Do lease terms support collectible stressed receipts?; value: Yes: advance; no: reprice or reject economics; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Read royalty language, deduction provisions, pooling authority, and payment history. Texas Natural Resources Code Section 91.402 addresses payment timing and specified withholding circumstances. Stress commodity prices and decline; determine asset-specific tax and depletion treatment under 26 U.S.C. Sections 611 and 613A.; label: Does the docket support the priced development case?; value: Yes: advance; no: remove unsupported development value; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Verify application status, issued orders, affected tracts, election provisions, and deadlines directly with the relevant commission. Texas Natural Resources Code Chapter 102 does not define Oklahoma pooling practice. Do not turn a public filing into assumed drilling, completion, or first-payment dates.; label: Is the funding structure documented before solicitation?; value: Yes: authorize closing; no: stop solicitation and remediate; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document owner-funded purchases separately from pooled investor offerings. Review 15 U.S.C. Sections 77b and 77e, any applicable exemption conditions, and relevant state securities requirements before soliciting funds. A direct-asset label does not settle whether the offered arrangement is a security.

text.title: Four Checks Before Capital Leaves the Acquisition Account
text.tspan: Four Checks Before Capital Leaves the Acquisition

rect.title: label: Does recorded title support the conveyed interest?; value: Yes: advance; no: cure title or reject; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Test seller authority, severed estate ownership, reservations, probate, liens, and execution formalities. For Texas assets, examine Property Code Sections 5.021 and 13.001. A recorder index hit alone does not establish marketable title or resolve competing interests.

text.title: Does recorded title support the conveyed interest?

Test seller authority, severed estate ownership, reservations, probate, liens, and execution formalities. For Texas assets, examine Property Code Sections 5.021 and 13.001. A recorder index hit alone does not establish marketable title or resolve competing interests.

rect.title: label: Do lease terms support collectible stressed receipts?; value: Yes: advance; no: reprice or reject economics; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Read royalty language, deduction provisions, pooling authority, and payment history. Texas Natural Resources Code Section 91.402 addresses payment timing and specified withholding circumstances. Stress commodity prices and decline; determine asset-specific tax and depletion treatment under 26 U.S.C. Sections 611 and 613A.

text.title: Do lease terms support collectible stressed receipts?

Read royalty language, deduction provisions, pooling authority, and payment history. Texas Natural Resources Code Section 91.402 addresses payment timing and specified withholding circumstances. Stress commodity prices and decline; determine asset-specific tax and depletion treatment under 26 U.S.C. Sections 611 and 613A.

rect.title: label: Does the docket support the priced development case?; value: Yes: advance; no: remove unsupported development value; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Verify application status, issued orders, affected tracts, election provisions, and deadlines directly with the relevant commission. Texas Natural Resources Code Chapter 102 does not define Oklahoma pooling practice. Do not turn a public filing into assumed drilling, completion, or first-payment dates.

text.title: Does the docket support the priced development case?

Verify application status, issued orders, affected tracts, election provisions, and deadlines directly with the relevant commission. Texas Natural Resources Code Chapter 102 does not define Oklahoma pooling practice. Do not turn a public filing into assumed drilling, completion, or first-payment dates.

rect.title: label: Is the funding structure documented before solicitation?; value: Yes: authorize closing; no: stop solicitation and remediate; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document owner-funded purchases separately from pooled investor offerings. Review 15 U.S.C. Sections 77b and 77e, any applicable exemption conditions, and relevant state securities requirements before soliciting funds. A direct-asset label does not settle whether the offered arrangement is a security.

text.title: Is the funding structure documented before solicitation?

Document owner-funded purchases separately from pooled investor offerings. Review 15 U.S.C. Sections 77b and 77e, any applicable exemption conditions, and relevant state securities requirements before soliciting funds. A direct-asset label does not settle whether the offered arrangement is a security.

Assumptions: Four sequential binary checks: a supported yes advances; an unresolved no routes the package to remediation or rejection. Numeric values indicate check order, not probability. Texas citations apply to Texas interests; Oklahoma docket practice requires its own commission records and governing rules.
